title: Attention Is All You Need for Transformer Networks
summary: Recurrent and convolutional neural networks are standard for translation. We propose the Transformer based solely on self-attention mechanisms with multi-head attention.

title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
summary: Deeper neural networks are harder to optimize. We present residual learning frameworks that reformulate layers as learning residual functions with reference to inputs on ImageNet.

title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
summary: We present a scalable approach for semi-supervised learning on graph-structured data using localized spectral graph convolutions.

title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: We introduce AlphaGo combining value networks to evaluate board positions and policy networks to select moves trained via reinforcement learning.

title: Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance for Replicated Services
summary: We describe a new Byzantine fault-tolerant algorithm for state machine replication that survives malicious attacks in asynchronous environments.

title: BERT Pretraining of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: We introduce BERT which pretrains deep bidirectional representations by conditioning on left and right context in all layers via masked language models.

title: YOLO You Only Look Once Unified Real-Time Object Detection
summary: We frame object detection as a regression problem to spatially separated bounding boxes and associated class probabilities using deep convolutional backbones.

title: Generative Adversarial Nets for Unsupervised Representation Learning
summary: We propose generative adversarial networks where a generative model captures data distribution while a discriminative model estimates probability of sample authenticity.

title: Asynchronous Methods for Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose asynchronous gradient descent for continuous control where actor-critic agents parallelize experience collection across multiple worker threads.

title: Raft In Search of an Understandable Consensus Algorithm
summary: Raft decomposes consensus into leader election, log replication, and safety guarantees with formal state invariants across distributed clusters.

title: RoBERTa A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
summary: We present a replication study of BERT showing that careful hyperparameter tuning, longer training, larger batch sizes, and dynamic masking improve performance.

title: Mask R-CNN for Instance Segmentation
summary: We extend Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting segmentation masks in parallel with the existing bounding box recognition branch.

title: Adam A Method for Stochastic Optimization in Deep Networks
summary: We introduce Adam, an algorithm for first-order gradient-based optimization of stochastic objective functions with adaptive learning rates based on moments.

title: Compiler Optimization for Domain Specific Hardware Accelerators
summary: We present polyhedral compilation techniques targeting systolic arrays and specialized tensor processing units with loop tiling and vectorization.

title: Zero-Knowledge Succinct Non-Interactive Arguments of Knowledge
summary: We formalize zk-SNARK protocols for verifying arbitrary NP computations with logarithmic proof size and sub-second verification times.

title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning
summary: We propose a novel family of policy gradient methods that clip probability ratios to prevent destructively large policy updates in continuous control.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
summary: We show that pure transformers applied directly to sequences of image patches perform exceptionally well on computer vision classification tasks.

title: Self-Supervised Learning of Graph Embeddings via Contrastive Pretraining
summary: We introduce a graph contrastive learning framework that maximizes agreement between augmented topological graph views via mutual information.

title: Static Analysis and Symbolic Execution for Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
summary: We build a symbolic virtual execution engine to detect reentrancy bugs, integer overflows, and unhandled exceptions in EVM bytecode.

title: Deep Speech 2 End-to-End Speech Recognition in English and Mandarin
summary: We describe an end-to-end deep learning system that handles noisy speech with convolutional layers, bidirectional recurrent cells, and CTC loss.

title: Convergence Analysis of Stochastic Gradient Descent in Non-Convex Hilbert Spaces
summary: We establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient algorithms under Polyak-Lojasiewicz inequality and relaxed variance bounds.

title: Uniform Geometric Ergodicity of Markov Semigroups on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We prove spectral gap estimates and log-Sobolev inequalities for diffusion operators on compact Riemannian manifolds with bounded Ricci curvature.

title: Hodge Classes and Étale Cohomology Rings on Projective Algebraic Varieties
summary: We study motivic decomposition and cycle classes on smooth projective varieties over finite fields using crystalline cohomology and p-adic Hodge theory.

title: Existence and Regularity of Weak Solutions to Quasilinear Elliptic Equations
summary: We prove Harnack inequalities and Hölder continuity for quasilinear divergence-form elliptic operators with singular drift vector fields.

title: Log-Concavity of the Characteristic Polynomial of Matroids and Chow Rings
summary: We establish Hodge-Riemann relations for matroid intersection theory, resolving Welsh's conjecture on log-concavity of independent sets.

title: Subconvexity Bounds for Automorphic L-Functions and Kuznetsov Trace Formulas
summary: We prove subconvexity bounds on the critical line for GL(2) automorphic L-functions using spectral decomposition of the hyperbolic Laplacian.

title: Symplectic Floer Homology and Lagrangian Intersections in Cotangent Bundles
summary: We construct filtered Floer homology groups for exact Lagrangian submanifolds, proving the Arnold conjecture for compact symplectic manifolds.

title: Monge-Ampere Equations and Calabi-Yau Metrics on Complex Kähler Manifolds
summary: We establish a priori C2 estimates and uniform Laplacian bounds for complex Monge-Ampère equations on compact Kähler manifolds.

title: Quasi-Periodic Solutions to Non-Linear Schrödinger Equations via KAM Theory
summary: We prove persistence of invariant tori for Hamiltonian infinite-dimensional partial differential equations with Dirichlet boundary conditions.

title: Classification of Finite Simple Groups and Modular Representation Theory
summary: We investigate blocks of defect zero and Harish-Chandra induction for finite groups of Lie type over algebraically closed fields.

title: Global Well-Posedness of Navier-Stokes Equations in Critical Besov Spaces
summary: We establish global existence of mild solutions to 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with small initial data in negative Besov regularity.

title: Duality Theory for Non-Convex Semidefinite Programming and Rank Relaxations
summary: We derive exact penalty functions and zero duality gap conditions for rank-constrained semidefinite optimization problems.

title: Extreme Value Theory for Long-Memory Stationary Gaussian Sequences
summary: We prove limit theorems for normalized maxima of Gaussian processes with fractional Brownian covariance kernels.

title: Intersection Theory on Deligne-Mumford Moduli Stacks of Stable Curves
summary: We compute Mumford tautological classes and intersection numbers of psi-classes on Deligne-Mumford compactifications of moduli spaces.

title: Ramsey Numbers and Hypergraph Regularity Lemmas
summary: We establish exponential lower bounds for multicolor hypergraph Ramsey numbers using probabilistic construction and quasirandomness.

title: Zeros of the Riemann Zeta Function on the Critical Strip and Pair Correlation
summary: We examine Montgomery's pair correlation conjecture and deduce spacing distributions of non-trivial zeros under Riemann Hypothesis.

title: Derived Categories of Coherent Sheaves and Fourier-Mukai Transforms
summary: We prove autoequivalence classifications for derived categories of K3 surfaces using lattice theory and bridgeland stability conditions.

title: Free Boundary Problems for Minimal Surfaces and Obstacle Problems
summary: We analyze the regularity of free boundaries for two-phase elliptic variational inequalities using monotonicity formulas.

title: Optimal Transport Distances and Ricci Curvature Bounds on Metric Measure Spaces
summary: We characterize synthetic Ricci curvature lower bounds via convexity of Boltzmann entropy along Wasserstein geodesics.

title: Asymptotic Expansion of Jacobi Polynomials and Orthogonal Ensembles
summary: We derive Riemann-Hilbert asymptotic expansions for orthogonal polynomials with varying exponential weights on the real line.

title: Continuous Quantum Error Correction on Superconducting Surface Code Qubits
summary: We demonstrate fault-tolerant quantum error correction suppressing phase-flip and bit-flip errors exponentially in a planar superconducting processor.

title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from Binary Black Hole Coalescence
summary: LIGO detectors recorded a gravitational wave transient consistent with general relativistic predictions for a binary black hole merger.

title: Majorana Zero Modes in Topological Semiconductor Superconductor Nanowires
summary: We demonstrate zero-bias conductance peaks in indium antimonide nanowires in proximity to aluminum superconductors, confirming Majorana bound states.

title: Precise Measurement of the Higgs Boson Mass and Decay Branching Fractions
summary: ATLAS and CMS experiments report combined measurements of Higgs boson couplings to vector bosons and fermions at 13 TeV collision energy.

title: Cosmological Parameters from Planck Cosmic Microwave Background Anisotropy
summary: Measurements of temperature and polarization power spectra from Planck satellite confirm six-parameter Lambda-CDM cosmological concordance.

title: Holographic Duality Between Anti-de Sitter Gravity and Superconformal Field Theories
summary: We calculate entanglement entropy and Wilson loops in AdS/CFT correspondence connecting N=4 Yang-Mills theory with string theory on AdS5 x S5.

title: Bose-Einstein Condensation in Dilute Alkali Atomic Gases
summary: We achieve Bose-Einstein condensation of rubidium atoms cooled below 170 nanokelvin using laser cooling and magnetic evaporative traps.

title: Neutrino Oscillation Parameters and Mass Hierarchy in Long-Baseline Detectors
summary: We measure muon neutrino disappearance and electron neutrino appearance probabilities, determining atmospheric mass splitting and mixing angles.

title: Thermodynamics of Kerr-Newman Black Holes and Hawking Radiation Flux
summary: We calculate quantum radiation emission spectra from rotating charged black hole horizons using quantum field theory in curved spacetime.

title: Fractional Quantum Hall Effect and Non-Abelian Anyon Statistics
summary: We probe fractional charge and braiding statistics of quasiparticles at Landau level filling factor 5/2 in high-mobility GaAs heterostructures.

title: Dark Matter Annihilation Cross Sections from Galactic Center Gamma-Ray Flux
summary: Fermi-LAT observations place upper bounds on thermal relic WIMP cross sections from diffuse gamma-ray excess searches in the Galactic center.

title: Quantum Teleportation of Discrete and Continuous Variable States
summary: We demonstrate high-fidelity quantum teleportation of photonic qubits across a free-space optical link using Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen entanglement.

title: Non-Perturbative QCD Lattice Simulations of Nucleon Axial Form Factors
summary: We compute nucleon axial charge and electromagnetic radii using 2+1 flavor lattice quantum chromodynamics at physical pion mass.

title: Exoplanet Atmosphere Transmission Spectroscopy with James Webb Space Telescope
summary: JWST NIRSpec observations reveal carbon dioxide and water vapor absorption features in the transmission spectrum of transiting hot Jupiter planets.

title: High-Temperature Superconductivity in Cuprate and Nickelate Thin Films
summary: We investigate d-wave pairing symmetry and antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations in infinite-layer nickelate superconductors under epitaxial strain.

title: Perturbative Unification of Gauge Couplings in Supersymmetric Grand Unified Theories
summary: We compute two-loop renormalization group equations for SU(5) and SO(10) SUSY GUT models consistent with precision electroweak LEP data.

title: Stochastic Gravitational Wave Background from Pulsar Timing Arrays
summary: NANOGrav reports evidence for an isotropic stochastic background of nanohertz gravitational waves consistent with supermassive black hole binaries.

title: Laser Interferometric Squeezed Vacuum Injection Beyond Standard Quantum Limit
summary: We inject frequency-dependent squeezed vacuum states into optical resonators to suppress quantum radiation pressure and shot noise simultaneously.

title: Non-Equilibrium Phase Transitions and Critical Quenches in Quantum Spin Chains
summary: We study dynamical quantum phase transitions following quantum quenches in transverse-field Ising models using tensor network approximations.

title: Quark-Gluon Plasma Hydrodynamics in Ultra-Relativistic Heavy Ion Collisions
summary: We analyze elliptic flow and shear viscosity to entropy density ratios in relativistic hydrodynamic simulations of gold-gold collisions at RHIC.

title: High-Dimensional Covariance Matrix Estimation via Adaptive Thresholding
summary: We investigate sparse covariance estimators when dimension p exceeds sample size n. We prove consistency in operator norm and minimax convergence rates.

title: Posterior Contraction Rates in Nonparametric Bayesian Regression Models
summary: We establish Bernstein-von Mises theorems for Gaussian process priors in functional linear regression, proving asymptotic coverage of credible sets.

title: Doubly Robust Estimation of Causal Treatment Effects in Cohort Studies
summary: We propose an augmented inverse propensity weighted estimator combining generalized additive propensity models with outcome regression.

title: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo on Riemannian Manifolds for High-Dimensional Posterior Sampling
summary: We utilize Riemannian geometry and Fisher information metrics to navigate complex posterior distributions with varying local curvature in MCMC.

title: Sharp Generalization Error Bounds for Deep Neural Networks via Rademacher Complexity
summary: We derive generalization bounds for multi-layer neural networks using localized Rademacher complexity and spectral norm capacity control.

title: Exact Post-Selection Inference and Polyhedral Conditioning for the Lasso
summary: We develop exact hypothesis testing methods for linear regression after variable selection via the Lasso by conditioning on polyhedral selection sets.

title: Empirical Bayes Methods for Large-Scale Simultaneous Hypothesis Testing
summary: We formulate local false discovery rate estimators using empirical Bayes non-parametric mixture deconvolution over z-score distributions.

title: Optimal Transport Distances for Two-Sample Testing in Multivariate Spaces
summary: We introduce permutation tests based on sliced Wasserstein distances to evaluate whether two high-dimensional distributions share identical density.

title: Variational Inference with Normalizing Flows for Complex Bayesian Posteriors
summary: We combine mean-field variational inference with invertible neural networks to generate flexible non-Gaussian posterior approximations.

title: Uniform Convergence and Concentration of Measure for U-Statistics in Metric Spaces
summary: We derive exponential concentration inequalities for degenerate U-statistics over Hoeffding decompositions in unbounded random variables.

title: Longitudinal Mixed-Effects Models for Irregularly Sampled Biomarker Trajectories
summary: We develop stochastic expectation-maximization algorithms for linear mixed models with non-ignorable missingness and autoregressive correlation.

title: Sparse Principal Component Analysis via Orthogonal Dictionary Learning
summary: We formulate sparse PCA as a regularized matrix factorization problem solved via alternating minimization with convergence guarantees.

title: Bayesian Non-Parametric Dirichlet Process Mixture Models for Density Estimation
summary: We derive Gibbs sampling routines for stick-breaking Dirichlet process mixtures and prove L1 posterior consistency for smooth density targets.

title: False Discovery Rate Control Under Arbitrary Covariance and Dependence
summary: We prove that Benjamini-Hochberg procedures control false discovery rates under positive regression dependency from a subset of null hypotheses.

title: Conformal Prediction Sets with Finite-Sample Valid Coverage Guarantees
summary: We construct distribution-free prediction intervals with exact marginal coverage guarantees using split conformal inference on holdout calibration data.

title: Spatial Point Process Modeling for Clustered Environmental Sensor Networks
summary: We fit log-Gaussian Cox processes with Matérn covariance structures to predict pollutant concentrations using integrated nested Laplace approximations.

title: Spectral Clustering and Minimax Error Rates in Stochastic Block Models
summary: We establish sharp threshold bounds for community detection in sparse network graphs using eigenvectors of the normalized graph Laplacian.

title: Robust Estimation of Location and Scatter Using Minimum Covariance Determinant
summary: We evaluate high-breakdown affine-equivariant estimators for multivariate location and scatter in the presence of severe asymmetric outliers.

title: Survival Analysis with Time-Varying Covariates and High-Dimensional Penalization
summary: We extend Cox proportional hazards models with elastic net regularization to identify genomic markers associated with patient survival times.

title: Sequential Monte Carlo Particle Filtering for Non-Linear State Space Models
summary: We introduce adaptive resampling schemes for particle filters in non-Gaussian dynamical tracking systems to alleviate particle degeneracy.

title: Atomic Accuracy Protein Structure Prediction with AlphaFold
summary: AlphaFold uses spatial graph networks and evolutionary attention to predict 3D coordinates of proteins directly from amino acid primary sequences.

title: Single-Cell RNA Sequencing and Trajectory Inference in Hematopoiesis
summary: We map cellular differentiation trajectories during bone marrow stem cell maturation using single-cell transcriptomics and diffusion pseudotime.

title: Spike-Timing-Dependent Plasticity in Recurrent Biological Neural Circuits
summary: We model biophysical Hodgkin-Huxley cortical neurons to determine how dendritic spine remodeling controls long-term potentiation and depression.

title: Stochastic Bursting and Master Equations in Gene Regulatory Networks
summary: We formulate chemical master equations to model transcriptional bursting, promoter switching, and mRNA synthesis validated by smFISH imaging.

title: Constraint-Based Genome-Scale Metabolic Flux Analysis in Microbial Systems
summary: Using 13C metabolic flux balance analysis, we identify enzymatic knock-out targets in Escherichia coli to maximize biosynthetic biofuel yields.

title: Compartmental Epidemic Transmission on Scale-Free Demographic Contact Networks
summary: We formulate SIR epidemic models on heterogeneous scale-free contact networks and compute analytical percolation thresholds for pathogen spread.

title: Cryo-EM Reconstruction of Ribosomal Subunit Translation Intermediates
summary: Cryo-electron microscopy single-particle analysis reveals high-resolution conformational states of the eukaryotic 80S ribosome during elongation.

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Off-Target Cleavage Prediction Using Deep Convolutional Networks
summary: We train sequence models on genome-wide cleavage assays to predict guide RNA off-target binding affinities and chromatin accessibility effects.

title: Neural Population Dynamics and Low-Dimensional Latent Manifolds in Motor Cortex
summary: High-density multi-electrode recordings during reaching tasks reveal that motor cortical activity reflects rotational dynamical trajectories.

title: Oscillatory Dynamics and Entrainment in Circadian Gene Clock Networks
summary: We analyze non-linear limit cycles in transcriptional-translational feedback loops governing molecular circadian rhythms in mammalian cells.

title: Cell Membrane Permeability and All-Atom Molecular Dynamics of Ion Channels
summary: We simulate voltage-gated potassium ion channels in lipid bilayers using all-atom molecular dynamics to resolve voltage-sensing gate motions.

title: Evolutionary Fitness Landscapes and Epistatic Interactions in Viral Genomes
summary: Deep mutational scanning of viral surface glycoproteins maps how higher-order epistatic interactions dictate antibody escape mutations.

title: High-Throughput Spatial Transcriptomics in Mammalian Brain Slices
summary: We combine multiplexed in situ hybridization with spatial indexing to resolve cell-type specific gene expression in intact neocortical tissue.

title: Synaptic Neurotransmitter Release Kinetics and Vesicle Pool Depletion
summary: We model calcium-triggered exocytosis at presynaptic active zones to predict short-term synaptic depression during high-frequency firing.

title: Synthetic Gene Circuit Construction for Programmable Cell Therapy
summary: We engineer mammalian synthetic Notch receptor circuits that activate chimeric antigen receptor expression strictly upon multi-antigen sensing.

title: Biomechanics of Flagellar Locomotion in Viscous Microfluidic Environments
summary: We measure hydrodynamics and flagellar propulsion of swimming microorganisms in low Reynolds number fluidic chambers using high-speed tracking.

title: Deep Learning for Quantitative Fluorescence Microscopy Cell Segmentation
summary: We train residual U-Net architectures to segment touching cell nuclei in multi-channel confocal fluorescence microscopy imaging datasets.

title: Phylogenetic Tree Inference from Whole-Genome Sequence Alignments
summary: We implement maximum likelihood phylogenetic algorithms with site-specific substitution rates to reconstruct ancient speciation branching.

title: Co-Translational Protein Folding and Ribosome Stalling Mechanics
summary: Optical tweezer force spectroscopy measures folding forces exerted by nascent polypeptide chains emerging from the ribosomal exit tunnel.

title: Tumor Microenvironment Clonal Evolution and Drug Resistance Mutations
summary: Whole-exome longitudinal sequencing of glioblastoma biopsies tracks subclonal evolutionary selection under alkylating chemotherapy agents.

title: Massive MIMO Channel Estimation and Signal Detection Using Deep Learning
summary: Millimeter-wave 5G massive MIMO requires accurate CSI. We introduce deep convolutional neural networks for compressed channel reconstruction.

title: Deep Physics-Guided Unrolled Networks for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
summary: Accelerated MRI reconstructs images from undersampled k-space data. We formulate an unrolled iterative network integrating coil sensitivity maps.

title: Model Predictive Control with Lyapunov Guarantees for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: We design an integrated MPC and reinforcement learning controller for high-speed vehicle trajectory tracking under uncertain tire friction.

title: Conformer Transducer Models for Real-Time Edge Hardware Speech Recognition
summary: We optimize 8-bit quantized conformer neural architectures for streaming automatic speech recognition on battery-powered microcontrollers.

title: Compressed Sensing Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging via ADMM Optimization
summary: We formulate radar image formation as an L1-regularized sparse inverse problem solved via alternating direction method of multipliers.

title: Decentralized Frequency Control for Low-Inertia Power Grids with Wind Energy
summary: We introduce robust H-infinity distributed control for battery energy storage systems to counter frequency volatility in low-inertia grids.

title: Deep Super-Resolution of Optical Satellite Imagery Using Attention GANs
summary: We design generative adversarial networks with multi-scale residual attention blocks to upscale low-resolution multispectral satellite images.

title: End-to-End Beamforming Optimization in Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces
summary: We formulate mutual coupling and phase-shift optimization for wireless communication networks assisted by reconfigurable intelligent metasurfaces.

title: Acoustic Echo Cancellation Using Kalman Filtering and Deep Neural Post-Filters
summary: We combine partitioned-block frequency-domain adaptive Kalman filtering with deep recurrent neural networks for nonlinear acoustic echo removal.

title: Fault Detection and Resilient Microgrid State Estimation via Graph Neural Nets
summary: We apply spatio-temporal graph neural networks to phasor measurement unit telemetry to isolate power transmission line faults in sub-cycle time.

title: Hyperspectral Image Denoising via Non-Local Low-Rank Tensor Decomposition
summary: We propose tensor subspace representation with non-local spatial regularization to remove mixed stripe and Gaussian noise from hyperspectral bands.

title: Orthogonal Time Frequency Space Modulation for High-Mobility Vehicular Wireless
summary: OTFS modulation multiplexes information symbols in the delay-Doppler domain. We construct low-complexity equalization algorithms for high Doppler.

title: Adaptive Cruise Control and Platoon String Stability in Connected Vehicles
summary: We develop distributed sliding mode controllers for connected vehicle platoons that guarantee string stability under wireless packet loss.

title: Deep Audio Source Separation for Multi-Speaker Mixtures with TasNet
summary: We implement time-domain audio separation networks with dilated convolutional encoders to isolate speech signals in challenging reverberant rooms.

title: Phase Retrieval in Optical Diffraction Tomography Using Deep Image Priors
summary: We solve holographic phase retrieval inverse problems by utilizing untrained convolutional networks as structural regularizers.

title: Energy-Efficient Resource Allocation in Cell-Free Massive MIMO Networks
summary: We optimize downlink power control and access point selection in cell-free networks using fractional programming and successive convex approximations.

title: Nonlinear Observer Design for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Charge Estimation
summary: We construct unscented Kalman filters combined with equivalent circuit electrochemical models to estimate state-of-charge under dynamic driving cycles.

title: Deep Video Frame Interpolation via Bi-Directional Optical Flow Synthesis
summary: We propose an end-to-end convolutional network with warp-and-blend architecture to generate intermediate video frames at high frame rates.

title: Speech Enhancement in Non-Stationary Acoustic Noise Using Spectral Masking
summary: We train dual-path recurrent neural networks on magnitude and complex spectra to restore speech intelligibility in cockpit environments.

title: Distributed Voltage Regulation in Active Distribution Feeders with Solar PV
summary: We propose decentralized peer-to-peer reactive power optimization to mitigate overvoltage conditions caused by rooftop solar photovoltaic generation.
